office_does: The three county commissioners are the county's legislative body: they adopt the budget and ordinances, set county taxes and manage county property, roads, buildings and jails.
race_blurb: Appointed incumbent JR Streifel (R), named to the seat in May after Vickie Raines resigned, faces Stan Sturgeon (no party preference), a former North Beach School Board member endorsed by Raines. Sturgeon led the District 3-only primary 54% to 31%; in November all county voters choose.

candidates.summary: North Beach School District facilities supervisor and business owner who served 12 years on the North Beach School Board and chairs the new Ocean City Drainage District.
highlights: Priorities: fiscal responsibility, family-wage jobs and affordable housing [S1]
Would support the Coastal Community Action Program and the county housing authority on affordable housing [S2]
Supports community policing and the Resident Officer Program [S2]
Endorsed by former Commissioner Raines, Mainstream Republicans of Washington and three labor organizations; recommended by the county Democrats [S2][S5]

experience.basis: Not a county incumbent, but runs on 12 years of school-board service (nine as president) and chairing the drainage district.

housing.basis: Housing plank relies on continued support for the community action program and the public housing authority; he is also endorsed by a builders' housing council.

spending.basis: Pairs a commitment to a balanced budget with continued investment in infrastructure.

safety.basis: Community policing and a resident-officer program alongside investment in crime-prevention programs and mental-health services.

candidates.summary: Appointed District 3 commissioner since May 2026, a former Aberdeen fire captain and Cosmopolis School Board member running on public safety, economic development and responsible budgeting.
highlights: Calls public safety one of his highest priorities, with leadership that supports law enforcement and first responders [S1]
Would address homelessness 'with compassion while maintaining accountability and protecting our neighborhoods' [S1]
Supports economic development that creates good-paying jobs and encourages local investment [S1]
Appointed by the board in May 2026 to the seat Vickie Raines vacated, until the 2026 general election is certified [S6]

experience.basis: Appointed incumbent with about five months in office and a long fire-service career, asking voters to let him continue.

safety.basis: Emphasizes supporting law enforcement and pairs compassion on homelessness with accountability and protecting neighborhoods.

spending.basis: General references to responsible budgeting and efficient use of taxpayer dollars, with no specific proposals.
